kai: heads-up — myrtle-9b-int4 canary nodes OOM after ~1k tokens on multi-turn convs. Repro on two machines.
rachel: any logs? where does it blow?
kai: snippet: [2025-10-12T09:03Z] OOM allocate(1.1GB) failed model=myrtle-9b-int4 node=canary-03 kv_usage=0.81 frag=0.31 batch=6 max_new=512
omar: int4 + high max_new_tokens + larger batches often triggers KV pressure and slab fragmentation.
liz: what are current canary defaults?
kai: config: max_batch_size=8 batch_window_ms=25 prefetch=true max_new_tokens=512 kv_eviction=off slot_compactor=off
rachel: quick mitigation plan: 1) lower max_new_tokens->256 2) reduce max_batch_size->4 3) enable kv_eviction trim=0.12 4) disable prefetch on canary
omar: add slot_compactor interval=60s too, low risk. Also add per-token mem traces.
ci-bot: deploy queued: myrtle-int4-canary-patch by kai.
kai: patched to canary small group. running bench now.
ci-bot: bench complete: throughput=2280 req/min p50=95ms p95=210ms OOMs=0 (2k reqs) quality delta vs int8 = -0.5% on long-turn set
rachel: good — OOMs resolved, quality hit reduced. keep canary at 10% and monitor 24h. Add auto-fallback rule: sustained >1% regression for 3h -> fallback to int8.
omar: create model profile defaults to codify these settings. I'll add dashboard traces for fragmentation.
kai: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/ml-profiles/pull/420
rachel: thanks team. follow-ups: profile merge, dashboard, cost/tok bench 24h.
